title: Legacy Core Glossary — steward-approved terms
count: 12 terms of ≈220 in the core glossary

prov.label: SIMULATED · would derive from: Collibra business glossary · mainframe domain steward council · batch runbook appendix

rows: Transaction log — the per-store register journal swept nightly at 01:15; the system of record for sales until posted by SLS0100
The continuously maintained on-hand quantity per store × item, held in VSAM INVMST; authoritative over any downstream copy
The on-hand threshold per store × item at which RPL2300 generates a requisition; recalculated nightly from forecast + lead time
Buffer quantity added to order point to cover demand variance during vendor lead time; set by service-level target (94–98%)
Rounding an order quantity up to the vendor case/pallet multiple; the last step before a requisition becomes a PO line
Weighted Average Cost — the inventory valuation method applied at receipt; the basis for GL inventory balances fed to SAP
Direct Store Delivery — vendor delivers to the store, bypassing DCs; invoiced and received at store level, reconciled centrally
02:00–06:00 — the contractual gap in which the nightly chain must complete; overrun delays store opens and e-com inventory
E-commerce mid-tier reading 3270 green screens as an unofficial API; ≈1.1M calls/day with no documented contract
Invoice (810) matched against PO and receipt before payment release; MCH0300 auto-matches 91%, exceptions to AP workbench
Framework letting an abended batch job resume from its last commit interval instead of rerunning from the start
Shared COBOL record layout included at compile time; ≈5,200 in the commons, a change can force recompiles across 3,000+ programs
